name: @jaybeeuu/agent-cortex
description: Personal PI package with custom agents, skills, and extensions

scripts.build: echo 'Build complete — no compilation needed for PI package'
scripts.lint: pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:sync && pnpm check:skills
scripts.publish-package: TARBALL=$(pnpm pack | tail -n 1) && npm publish "$TARBALL" --provenance --access public
scripts.publish-noop: echo 'No publish: the merged PR carries the no-publish label.'
